text: This might be a silly one, sorry. I'm a childminder with a little girl staying over, 21 months old. I think she's a bit warm, 37.7 when I checked. She hasn't done a poo for three days I believe, going by what mum said plus today, and she's quite grumpy about it, pushing and not getting anywhere. She's eating and drinking normally though. Mum has said I can give medicine, but I'm not sure how much paracetamol or ibuprofen is right for her age, or whether she even needs it at that temperature.
